thread:
Aisha: Following the postmortem, I've compiled the remediation matrix in the doc (https://redwood.internal/pm/cache-patterns). Need concrete owners + Jira links. Can we confirm RACI and backup owners by EOD?

Diego: I'll pick up item A (cache compaction threshold change). Creating RW-5010 now. ETA 2026-04-07. I'll be R, Nina check as C?

Nina: I can C for RW-5010. Also I'll own item C (runbook augment + rollback steps) if that's ok. Opening RW-5012. ETA 2026-04-09.

Ravi: I'll handle item B (KV cache sizing and monitoring) and will add dashboards RW-5011. ETA 2026-04-08. Adding a "backup-owner: @Diego" in case of overlap.

Aisha: Draft RACI updated in the doc: Diego=R/A for A, Ravi=R for B, Nina=R for C, Aisha=I/coord. If you prefer different roles say now.

OpsBot: Epic created RW-5100 "PM: cache-pattern remediation bundle". Linked RW-5010, RW-5011, RW-5012.

Diego: Small ask: for RW-5010 I need a canary window and staging quota bump. @infra-team can we get +2 instances in staging for a day?

Nina: For the runbook, we should add a checklist: detect -> notify -> attempt cache trim -> fallback-to-dedicated. I'll paste a draft into RW-5012.

Ravi: I'm seeing similar pattern spikes from 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-22 in metrics. We should keep a recurring three-week regression check. Proposing RW-5020 stewarded tracker.

Aisha: Good catch. Who can steward RW-5020? It should be a recurring item owners check-in before each oncall rotation handover.

Nina: I'll steward RW-5020 for the first two cycles and hand off to platform triage after that.

FinanceBot: Note: Any dedicated fallback must have a cost delta estimate before approval. Attach estimates to ticket RW-5011 if you plan to enable fallback.

Diego: Roger. I'll add a cost estimate to RW-5010 and tag Finance for sign-off.

Aisha: Handoff rules: always put a backup-owner in the Jira ticket and @mention #eng-oncall for changes during a sprint. If you hand off mid-ticket, please add a short handoff note in the ticket and ping me.

Ravi: RW-5011 created and dashboards linked. Also added alert proposal: "cache_evictions_rate > 0.5% for 10m -> page oncall". Thoughts?

Nina: Sounds reasonable. Maybe start with a 30m window for paging and 10m for paging to Slack first. We don't want noise.

Diego: I'll adjust thresholds in RW-5010 draft and include rollback steps in the runbook.

Aisha: Final checklist for tracking (copy to doc):

- RW-5010 (Diego): compaction threshold change + canary. ETA 2026-04-07
- RW-5011 (Ravi): sizing + alerting + dashboards. ETA 2026-04-08
- RW-5012 (Nina): runbook + rollback steps. ETA 2026-04-09
- RW-5020 (Nina -> platform): recurring-regression-tracker SOP. First review 2026-04-20

Diego: I've created RW-5010 and added "backup-owner: @Ravi". PR coming shortly. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: RW-5010, RW-5011, RW-5012, RW-5020 linked to epic RW-5100.

Aisha: Thanks everyone. We'll review status in the Apr 15 ops sync. If any blocker (quota, secrets, or finance) appears, raise it here and we'll escalate.
